children: Cardinal Health secured a $1.5 billion government contract as part of the Defense Department's Medical Surgical Prime Vendor program.
The fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contracts were awarded as part of a competitive bidding process, the department said Tuesday. Eight bids were submitted.
The award is a two-year. six-month base contract, and includes three two-year six-month option periods. The ordering period end date is Dec. 6, 2029, the department said.
The contracting activity was handled by the Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support in Philadelphia.
